knowledge_checks.title: Active Recall: 4.2.5
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. (1) Define the linear predictor. (2) Give one simple η form. (3) Give one form involving a factor or polynomial term. (4) Name one reason deviance is not today's LO.
hints: Use CMP language from today's notes.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: η is the linear predictor (typically Xβ). Example: η=β0+β1x; or with factor indicators / polynomial powers. Deviance/estimation is tomorrow.
knowledge_checks.common_mistake: Skipping the LO hinge or swallowing the next LO.

knowledge_checks.title: Checkpoint: 4.2.5
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. Poisson claim counts with log link, continuous exposure score x and two-level factor cover (Standard/Plus). (1) Write η for a model with x, a quadratic term in x, and cover. (2) Refuse: 'The link function is the linear predictor.'
knowledge_checks.model_answer: (1) η = β₀ + β₁x + β₂x² + β₃ I_Plus (Standard baseline). (2) Refuse: η = Xβ is the linear predictor; the link g maps mean μ to η (e.g. log(μ)=η for Poisson log).
